long_biography.plain_text:
Grupo Plimon brought manufacturing and raw-material distribution under one strategy, serving personal-care, food and pharmaceutical producers. From the chairman's office, Lascorz oversaw plants making vegetable oils, biocides and formulations, while using overseas partners to widen the Catalan group's reach.

When the natural-oils division changed hands, the buyer retained its processing and formulation operation but left Plimon's Spanish distribution arm with the former owners. Lascorz stayed involved during the combination. His next operating chapter was at GP Textron Iberia, where registered appointments as president and joint chief executive placed him back in industrial chemistry. The company supplies auxiliaries for textile preparation, printing, dyeing and finishing.
